notes.title: Bug fixes and gameplay improvements
notes.notes:
- Issue with VR being launched on game start should be solved
- Improved gameplay of Brave Little Dragon to reduce motion sickness
- Fixed issue with losing mouse control when switching levels
- Changed Brave Little Bear start area to reduce time running doing nothing at the start

notes.title: Performance improvement, minor gameplay adjustment and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Brave Little Cat
- Performance improvements
- Improved air control while jumping
- Resorted levels by difficulty
- Fixed an issue with respawning and life loss in one of the levels

Brave Little Bear
- Performance improvements
- Fixed a bug with traps not damaging the player
- Fixed an issue with the full screen resolution change
- Fixed a bug with skill selection
